parameters.query:
select coalesce(json_agg(c), '[]') as credits from (select id, source, external_id, round(amount_zar*100)::bigint as amount_cents, reference_raw, parsed_reference, received_at, match_status, statement_confirmed_at
from public.bank_credits where received_at > now() - interval '35 days') c;

select (select coalesce(json_agg(i), '[]') from (select id, reference, status, round(total_zar*100)::bigint as total_cents, due_at, paid_at from public.invoices_smc where issued_at > now() - interval '120 days') i) as invoices,
(select coalesce(json_agg(c), '[]') from (select id, source, round(amount_zar*100)::bigint as amount_cents, reference_raw, received_at, match_status, statement_confirmed_at from public.bank_credits where received_at > now() - interval '35 days' or match_status = 'unmatched') c) as credits;
insert into ops.billing_reports (day, status, report) values ($1::date, $2, $3::jsonb) on conflict (day) do update set status = excluded.status, report = excluded.report;
